fields.name: ParameterCollection ordered database-parameter collection
fields.contract: ParameterCollection supplies the parameter sequence of a Query contract. It exposes Count, collection synchronization, enumeration, and CopyTo for the current ordered sequence. DbParameter values may be appended, range-appended in input order, inserted at a position, replaced at a position or matching name, removed by value, position, or matching name, or all cleared. Positional lookup returns the item at that position. Name-based Contains and IndexOf scan the sequence from the beginning; a matching name resolves to its first occurrence, and name-based parameter retrieval returns null when no name matches. Add returns the collection count after append.
